Evan K.: small ops question - hardware partner asked if we enforce partner-aware demo scheduling. they want to prevent two SIs booking the same on-site demo in same week.

Rina J.: we should, especially for constrained HW lab slots. propose marketplace listing include 'demo_slots' calendar and any SI that books blocks it for 7 days; others get a 'request' badge to queue.

Luis H.: +1. also need fallback: if SI cancels, release immediately and notify next in queue. automation: calendar webhook + queue management.

partner-bot: created PART-HW-88: "Marketplace demo slot reservation + queueing" assigned to @Luis H.

Evan K.: fine to pilot with LabX partner only. Rina can you own partner comms?

Rina J.: will do. will craft message template and publish to partner portal.

(End of thread)
